g.text: Seafood production: wild fish catch vs. aquaculture
Aquaculture means raising fish and other seafood — including molluscs, crustaceans and aquatic plants — in
farms. Capture fishery production is how much wild fish is caught, whether for commercial, industrial,
Data source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), via World Bank (2026)
